title: Ckly´s Optimized
description: An ultra-optimized Fabric Vanilla+ modpack focused on maximum performance (VulkanMod), full controller support, easy multiplayer (e4mc), and visual enhancements
body:
# Vanilla+ Reimagined

> This lightweight Fabric modpack is designed to be the ultimate foundation for any Minecraft player. It focuses on extreme optimization, modern visuals, and seamless accessibility while staying 100% faithful to the original Vanilla gameplay.
> Key Features:

- Extreme Performance: Powered by VulkanMod and Lithium, this pack moves beyond traditional rendering to offer some of the highest frame rates possible in modern Minecraft.
  
- Modern Controller Support: Includes Controlify, providing a native-feeling console experience with full controller compatibility and haptic feedback support.
  
- Visual Excellence: Full support for Shaders (Iris), Connected Textures (Continuity), and custom entity models/textures (EMF/ETF) for a beautiful, immersive world.
  
- Effortless Multiplayer: Featuring e4mc, allowing you to open your local world to friends instantly without the need for a dedicated server or port forwarding.
  
- Quality of Life: Enhanced with Zoomify, BetterGrassify, and a polished UI to make your daily survival experience smoother than ever.
